courseLine: Curated safety + instrument primers · pipettes, centrifuges, spectrophotometers, burners

prompts.title: Lab orientation: PPE, SDS, and risk assessment before touching equipment
prompts.query: Create a beginner-friendly wet-lab onboarding plan for biochemistry students. Cover required PPE, how to read Safety Data Sheets (SDS), hazard labeling, waste streams, and a pre-experiment risk assessment checklist.

prompts.title: Chemical hygiene plan in practice: translating policy into bench SOPs
prompts.query: Explain how to convert a chemical hygiene plan into daily bench behavior in a biochemistry lab. Include storage, labeling, transport, spill response, and documentation habits.

prompts.title: Micropipette fundamentals: selecting ranges and avoiding volume error
prompts.query: Teach micropipette basics for a new biochemistry student: choosing the right pipette range, setting volume correctly, first-stop/second-stop technique, and common mistakes that cause under/over-pipetting.

prompts.title: Pipetting accuracy: pre-wetting, immersion depth, and consistency drills
prompts.query: Design a 30-minute practice routine to improve pipetting accuracy and precision in biochemistry labs. Include tip pre-wetting, immersion depth, aspiration/dispense speed, and ways to self-check repeatability.

prompts.title: Centrifuge safe loading: balancing patterns and counterweights
prompts.query: Explain centrifuge loading and balancing for beginners. Show how to balance 2, 3, 4, and odd-number tube layouts, when to use balance tubes, and what can fail if loads are uneven.

prompts.title: Centrifuge biohazard controls: sealed rotors, cups, and aerosol risk
prompts.query: Teach safe centrifuge operation for potentially biohazardous samples: sealed buckets/rotors, inspection checks, rotor speed limits, decontamination workflow, and incident response after tube breakage.

prompts.title: Spectrophotometer basics: absorbance, blanking, and Beer-Lambert intuition
prompts.query: Explain spectrophotometry to a biochemistry beginner: absorbance vs transmittance, why blanking is needed, and how Beer-Lambert law connects concentration to measured signal.

prompts.title: Cuvette technique: handling, orientation, and contamination control
prompts.query: Provide a step-by-step protocol for cuvette handling in spectrophotometer workflows: cleaning, orientation, avoiding fingerprints/bubbles, and when to use quartz vs plastic cuvettes.

prompts.title: Fume hood workflow: sash height, airflow discipline, and setup
prompts.query: Explain how to use a laboratory chemical fume hood correctly in wet-lab biochemistry. Include pre-use checks, sash positioning, keeping materials out of dead zones, and behavior that defeats hood protection.

prompts.title: Bunsen burner safety: flame states, ignition sequence, and shutdown
prompts.query: Teach safe Bunsen burner operation in a biochemistry teaching lab: pre-checks, ignition order, visible safety flame vs working flame, tie-back/clearance rules, and emergency shutdown steps.

prompts.title: Glassware + heating devices: preventing thermal shock and burns
prompts.query: Create a practical guide for heating-related safety in biochemistry labs, covering hot plates, Bunsen burners, suitable glassware, gradual heating/cooling, and burn/thermal-shock prevention.

prompts.title: From device manual to SOP: writing reproducible one-page protocols
prompts.query: Show me how to turn a vendor manual for a lab device into a one-page SOP a beginner can follow. Include sections for purpose, setup, calibration, run steps, safety controls, and troubleshooting.
